steps.step: Pass plays with tracking in the release
Removed: no released man/zone label (label field empty)
Removed: fewer than 4 coverage defenders or 3 route runners tracked at the snap
Removed: thrown before 1.0 seconds (fewer than 11 frames), or too few tracked players at that frame
Removed: thrown before 1.5 seconds (fewer than 16 frames), or too few tracked players at that frame

funnel.rule: A play is evaluated only if it has features in every window, so every model and window is scored on the same plays. Short sequences are excluded, never padded or extrapolated.

short_throws.note: These plays are in the test weeks but outside the main comparison. They were never used for training, calibration or threshold choice. Each is scored by the latest window it has frames for.

groups.group: Thrown between 1.0 and 1.5 seconds: scored with the snap + 1s model
Thrown before 1.0 seconds: scored with the at-snap model

error_analysis.note: Descriptive breakdown of locked-test errors. Read after the models were frozen; not used to change them.

team_holdout.design: 4 folds of 8 defenses (alphabetical, every 4th team). Weeks 1-14 only: the locked test weeks are not used. All games involving a held-out team, on either side of the ball, are removed from training (weeks 1-12) and calibration (weeks 13-14). Scored on those teams' defensive plays. Same model settings as the main run; nothing tuned.

multiclass_dev.status: Development only. Trained on weeks 1-12 and scored on weeks 13-14. The locked test weeks have not been scored for this task, so there is no final multiclass result yet.
